title: pitch-keypoints audit 3: the extractor configurations E1-E3, declared before the audit reads any StatsBomb data (ticket 04)
ticket: pitch-keypoints 04 (declaration and audit); council C3 Q3 (config space); the owner lifted Q26 for this audit (spec, Owner's decision 2026-10-13)
rules: Unchanged and frozen (xg-detector spec, Audit; tickets 02 and 09): the chosen configuration has the lowest median shot-location error among those with shot-location coverage >= 70% of the paired non-penalty shots, ties broken by coverage; approach 2 reopens only if that median is <= 3 m at coverage >= 70% and goalkeeper information covers >= 50%. Same paired shots (2,721 non-penalty shots in 135 matches), same match draws (5,000, seed 0). StatsBomb is diagnostic only: no configuration is added, changed or tuned after the audit runs. Audit 2's choice D3 is audited alongside as a reference, never a candidate, and must reproduce audit 2's metric rows exactly.

extractor: experiments/claude_fable/xgpoc/detector/extract3.py CONFIGS['E1'..'E3'] (SourceConfig.source: the ordered offsets whose ball places the shot; a row never reads a frame after its own; without a ball of the order the flagged shooter of xg-detector's rule); scripts/pk_extract3.py runs them on the paired shots, one shared pass; tests/test_pk_audit3.py ties CONFIGS to this file

E1.role: audit 2's source rule (D3's: the t0 ball, else the -400 ms ball, else the -800 ms ball), with only the pitch keypoint model and its homography settings swapped (council C3 Q3)

E2.role: a fixed order over -400 / -800 ms: the -400 ms ball, else the -800 ms ball; never the t0 ball (without either, the flagged shooter)

E3.role: E2's order with the t0 ball as the last fallback, before the flagged shooter

evidence.provenance: The idea of taking the ball from the -400 ms frame came from audit 2's StatsBomb diagnostics (results_reports/xg_detector_2026-10/AUDIT.md, section 10.7: in D3 the -400 ms ball group had a 6.0 m median error against 11.9 m for the t0 ball). Those StatsBomb numbers do not justify E2/E3; the evidence below uses SoccerNet GSR ball positions only and no StatsBomb data (council C3 Q3).

truth_timing.data: GSR's ball positions (bbox_pitch) of the 21 GSR train + valid clips whose action is 'Shots on target' / 'Shots off target' (the xG index's classes), anchored like the index's shots (t0 = the latest frame at or before the action time); annotations only, no detector
truth_timing.kick: kick.kick on the truth's track over t0 - 1 s .. t0 + 0.28 s finds a kick in 11 of 21 clips (GSR's ball tracks are smooth, so many shots do not pass the velocity-change test); median kick time -240 ms
truth_timing.reading: By t0 the ball has usually left the spot it was struck from; the -400 ms ball is nearest to it and the -800 ms ball next, the t0 ball farthest. This orders the sources as -400, -800, t0 (E2, E3).

pipeline_on_gsr_valid_shot_clips.ball_placed: 51% of the frames (truth ball on 97%); placed balls 1.55 m median from the truth, 27% more than 5 m away (another object)

rules_against_the_truth_kick_spot.E1: 6 clips compared, median 1.91 m, 5 within 5 m
rules_against_the_truth_kick_spot.E3: as E2 (every clip had a -400 or -800 ms ball)

pipeline_on_gsr_valid_shot_clips.reading: Too few clips to rank the orders; where the detector finds the ball at -400 ms it is sometimes another object. E1 stays the reference rule; E2 and E3 rest on the truth timing above.

ball_placement_gsr_valid.data: every 5th frame of the 58 GSR valid clips with a truth ball on the pitch (6,404 frames); the detector's most confident ball placed by ticket 03's cached kp03_r2_refined homography
ball_placement_gsr_valid.all: placed on 50.2% [42.1; 58.2] of the frames; median error 1.42 m [1.22; 1.77]; < 2 m 59.6%; > 5 m 25.1% of the placed balls
ball_placement_gsr_valid.reading: When the detector finds the ball, the new homography places it about 1-1.5 m from GSR's position; a quarter of the placed balls are another object. The ball detector, not the homography, limits the shot location; no detector setting is changed in this audit.

evidence.kick_rule_not_declared: Council C3 Q3 also allowed a label-free kick-frame rule from the ball track over t0 - 1 s .. t0 + 0.3 s. On the 9 GSR valid shot clips the rule on the detector's track (kick.kick, the same thresholds as on the truth) found a kick in 5 clips; against the truth kick spot (4 clips compared) its median error is 13.6 m, with 2 of 4 on another object about 24 m away, because the detector places the ball on only half of the window's frames and a quarter of those elsewhere. It is therefore not declared.
